text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket hasn't shown up for training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's strange, because she always fully applies herself to practice. Wondering if something happened, I hurry out to look for her.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yaaay, I did it! I finally got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spot Ticket coming out of a sports supply store near the station.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hehe, the clerk was so kind. ♪ We ended up having a whole conversation!
choice_data_list: You seem to be in a good mood!
You seem to be in a good mood!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Well, yeah! I'm feeling great!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You'll never guess why! You know my favorite cycling gear brand, Two-Five Double?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Well, I managed to get my hands on one of their mega-premium items! ♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I've never been able to get one before, but my cycling buddy told me about this sale!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: When I saw it in real life, it looked even better than I expected! Two-Five Double gear really is the greatest!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! I totally forgot about it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I warn Winning Ticket to pay more attention next time.
